Build against Acme Notes API S21 api_version v1 with api.base_path AX-18174 and api.error_format AX-29401; the api_version values for S01-S20 belong to other sprints and do not govern S21.

Use the security team's scheme, JWT bearer tokens (RS256), for all user traffic; it governs over the Globex request for a long-lived X-Api-Key because long-lived static keys are weaker. Globex's request is not adopted as-is: we will follow up separately on a scoped, revocable machine credential (e.g. short-lived tokens via a non-interactive client-credentials flow) for their back-office scripts.

Reuse the S13 API-key header (X-Core-Key) this sprint. The S07 Bolt Billing API billing cycle could not be found in team memory, so it is not reused and not invented; it is flagged as missing in billing-plan.md. The code settings billing.cycle and billing.currency are stated as they are in repo/billing.py.
Adopt API v2 as updated by the researcher in the latest api_version fact (S21); it supersedes earlier api_version values for Acme Notes API.

Approve the CRUD spec: the S21 API version is v2 (the other sprints' versions are not relevant to S21), and the crud-spec artifact was verified. Recall returned no S21 auth fact, so only the S21 version fact is relied on.
Approve the CRUD spec: the S21 api_version is v2, and the artifact was independently verified.
